subject: Operations
title: Competing on Quality
description: A fast breakdown of Competing on Quality for builders.

hook.text: A $300 knife that lasts 30 years beats a $30 knife replaced every year. Quality earns premium prices.

buildup.text: Quality as a competitive priority means consistently meeting or exceeding customer expectations for performance.

discovery.text: It has two dimensions: design quality (features, performance) and conformance quality (consistency, zero defects).

twist.text: High quality doesn't always mean expensive. It means doing what you promised—reliably, every single time.

climax.text: Lexus entered the luxury market by matching BMW's quality at a lower price. Quality plus value was unstoppable.

punchline.text: Quality is a promise kept, every time.

quiz.question: What are the two dimensions of quality?
